column1: # S6: the effect package (P-file) loader (state item, old, new, size, note)
block chain walk and per-block parsers
column2: vs_effects_bindEffectPackageBlocks plus twelve owned one-line routes (_parsePfileBlock1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, _parsePfileCurveBlock), each storing a pointer into vs_effects_package
column3: effect_package.zig: bind(first) walks the chain and fills the record; the file's layout is its header comment; the routes, their ownership entries, root.zig imports and C prototypes are removed
